title: The Booking page is in the menu, turned off for now
text: The Booking page is in the menu for you, turned off for now. Open it to look around: pick a person, the kind of call and the length, and see what the system will do when it is booked. While it is off, nothing on the page works and it says so ("Turned off. Nothing here is live yet."). When it is turned on you can copy a link, see every link you made and stop one. A section at the bottom, Calls to check, holds the bookings the system could not settle by itself. The day-to-day Calendar is not changed. Also fixed: a second call on the same day no longer vanishes from a contact's Booked calls.
